blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理人越来越多地通过平行推理和同步信息收集来解决复杂的任务. 对两个模范家庭和三个基准进行有控制的再演显示,尽管初步证据相同,交付时间会改变在所有结果到达之前作出的搜索决定。 采购方面的分歧比同级重复变化高出24个百分点。 在所有初步证据到来之后,这种依赖性继续存在,并通过第二次调查,将代理人所看到的暂时性差异转变为他们所获得的持久差异。 配有相配构件的购置-监管程序表明,在固定的提前到达计数时的不一致性会限制已经收到证据的使用. 我们引入了Confluent Information(CEA),它反而在每一个子问题的证据完成后释放出本地推理,并且将共享搜索与完成令分开分配. 对于一个固定的计划和稳定的有条件反应法,我们证明了共同的对决定、收购和答案的偏颇。 由于有三个基准的仅限问题计划,CEA将采购方面的分歧提高到了重复变化的1.0个百分点以内,并实现了与完全投入控制相当的准确性,比早期承诺提高了12.6个百分点。 将CEA的固定分配额改为争议中的先备分配额,增加了21.6%的购置分歧,而当地查询-目标分歧则几乎重复。 时间比较表明,CEA比同一程序更早达成决定,并比等待所有初始证据的同一程序更快的响应.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Progress in reasoning and tool use enables language-model agents to tackle increasingly complex tasks requiring sustained information gathering across multiple subtasks ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Parallel search and asynchronous execution let these subtasks advance while tool results are still arriving ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Hooper et al., 2026 ) . In agentic search, reasoning and information acquisition evolve together, as an arriving result can guide a new query before other calls finish. Whether execution timing changes the evidence ultimately acquired is a reliability question for Web agents.
blocks.zh: 推理和工具使用方面的进展使语言模型代理人能够处理日益复杂的任务,需要持续收集跨多个分任务的信息(徐等,2026年)。 平行搜索和同步执行让这些子任务在工具结果仍在到达时推进(Tan等,2025;Hooper等,2026.). 在代理搜索中,推理和信息获取会一起演化出来,因为一个到达的结果可以指导一个新的查询,而后其他调用完成. 对Web代理来说,执行时间是否改变最终获得的证据是一个可靠性问题.

blocks.en: An intermediate fact can arrive in time for final reasoning yet too late to guide search. Figure 1 shows two recorded runs for a question comparing directors’ death dates ( Ho et al., 2020 ) . Both receive the same original documents and have one search opportunity. With a director’s name available early, one run retrieves his biography. The other spends its search identifying him. Both eventually receive the name, but only one acquires the date and answers correctly. The scheduler acts as a hidden retriever by determining which supplied evidence can guide the next query, a mechanism we call temporal evidence selection .

blocks.en: We replay identical evidence packets in different delivery orders to examine early commitment , when an agent decides whether and what to search before all results arrive. Across three benchmarks and two model families, early commitment produces acquisition disagreement up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. Presenting the received documents in a fixed order does not remove the effect, because the evidence available at commitment still differs. Timing also changes whether missing supporting evidence is recovered. Acquisition differences persist after all original evidence arrives and through a second search. In the two-search evaluation, early commitment improves accuracy but leaves acquisition more sensitive to timing. Average accuracy captures task success but cannot establish whether supporting evidence is acquired reproducibly, a distinction that matters when auditing an agent’s conclusions ( Vashagh, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们重放相同的证据包 在不同交付命令 检查早期的承诺, 当一个代理决定 是否和如何搜索 所有结果到达之前。 在三个基准和两个模范家庭中,早期承诺造成购置分歧,最高高出同级重复变化24个百分点。 以固定顺序提交收到的文件并不能消除影响,因为承诺时提供的证据仍然不同。 时机也改变是否找到缺失的佐证证据。 在所有原始证据到来后,通过第二次搜查,采购差异依然存在。 在两次研究评价中,及早承诺可提高准确性,但对时间的获取更为敏感。 平均准确性可以捕捉任务的成功,但不能确定是否可复制获得佐证证据,这种区分在审计代理人的结论时很重要(Vashagh, 2026)。

blocks.en: These findings motivate acquisition that is both useful and stable. We formalize schedule invariance as an unchanged acquisition or answer distribution across delivery orders. Our acquisition-regret bound, with a matching construction, shows that enforcing invariance at a fixed early arrival count can restrict the use of informative evidence already received. A shared-budget counterexample shows that even invariant local proposals can yield different acquisitions when completion order determines which query executes. Under search contention, this allocation rule adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Stable acquisition involves both the evidence dependencies that govern query formation and the resource dependencies that govern execution.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果激励着既有用又稳定的获取。 我们正式确定无变化的时间表,作为未变的购货或答复在交货订单中的分配。 我们的收购-注册绑定,加上配套的构筑物,表明在固定的提前到达计数时强制执行的偏差会限制已经收到的信息证据的使用. 一个共享预算反例显示,即使本地建议不尽相同,在完成令决定执行哪个查询时,也可以产生不同的收购. 在搜索争议中,这一分配规则增加了21.6%的购置分歧,而当地查询-目标分歧仍然几乎重复。 稳定的获取涉及制约查询形成的证据依赖性和制约执行的资源依赖性。

blocks.en: We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA) to retain the stability and answer quality of complete-input reasoning while allowing asynchronous progress. Reasoning on each subquestion begins once its evidence is complete, without waiting for unrelated results. A schedule-independent allocation rule determines which proposed search executes. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove epistemic confluence , meaning that local decisions, executed acquisitions, and the final answer have a schedule-invariant joint distribution. With question-only plans and evidence assigned by retrieval-call ownership, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation across three benchmarks. Accuracy is comparable to complete-input controls and improves over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. In timed comparisons, CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了“合并证据获取”(CEA),以保持完全投入推理的稳定性和回答质量,同时允许同步进展。 每一分问题一旦证据齐全,即开始提出理由,而不等待不相关的结果。 一个独立的调度分配规则决定了哪些请求执行。 对于固定的计划和稳定的有条件反应法, 我们证明了感知性交汇, 意思是地方决定, 执行收购, 以及最后的答案 都有一个不固定的时间表 联合分配。 由于只有问题计划和证据由检索-调用所有权指定,CEA将采购方面的分歧带到三个基准重复变化的1.0个百分点以内。 准确性相当于完全投入控制,比早期承诺提高12.6%。 在有时间的比较中,CEA更早地达成决定,并比等待所有初步证据的同一程序更快的响应.

blocks.en: We make three contributions. • Temporal evidence selection. We isolate how delivery timing redirects retrieval and show why acquisition stability must be assessed alongside evidence quality and answer accuracy. • Structural limits of early invariance. We derive an acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction and show how shared-budget allocation introduces a separate source of instability. • Dependency-scoped coordination. CEA coordinates local evidence completion and shared search allocation, guaranteeing joint invariance for a fixed plan. It achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls with earlier decisions and faster responses.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 • 临时证据选择。 我们孤立了交付时间如何改变检索方向,并表明为什么必须评估购置的稳定性,同时评估证据质量和答案的准确性。 • 早期变化的结构限制。 我们得出了与匹配的构筑物相联的购置条例,并表明共享预算分配如何带来另一个不稳定的来源。 • 依赖范围的协调。 CEA协调当地证据的完成和共享的搜索分配,保证固定计划的共同变化. 其准确性可与早期决定和更快反应的完全投入控制相媲美。

Support is neither inserted nor withheld, and annotations are used only for scoring (Section 5.2 ).

blocks.en: The agent chooses search(query) or answer(answer) . We release the decision after two or six arrivals to compare commitment during delivery, as asynchronous runtimes permit ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Hooper et al., 2026 ) , with commitment after completion. This isolates evidence availability. Always waiting recovers the complete-input regime. Native strategies update notes in arrival order, whereas batch strategies use canonical identifier order. These yield native@2 , native@6 , wait_all@2 , and wait_all@6 . Prefix batches fix presentation order but vary which documents are available. Complete batches fix both. CEA reasons on completed domains and coordinates shared search allocation (Section 4 ).

Permutation experiments evaluate each question under eight fixed delivery orders, with two independent runs per order. blocks.en: 3. How Scheduling Shapes Information Acquisition

blocks.en: 3.1. Scheduling Selects the Evidence for Search
blocks.zh: 3.1. 时间安排选择搜索证据

blocks.en: Delivery can affect a search decision through the evidence available at commitment or the order in which it is processed. Figure 2 shows the primary analysis; Appendix Figure E1 reports the GPT replication. Batch 6/6 ( wait_all@6 ) presents all six documents in a fixed order, whereas Notes 6/6 ( native@6 ) accumulates notes in arrival order. Both show little excess retrieval disagreement when all six documents are available for the first decision.
blocks.zh: 交付可通过承付时掌握的证据或处理的顺序影响查询决定。 图2显示的是初级分析;附录图E1报告GPT的复制. 批次 6/6 (wait_all@6 ) 以固定顺序提交所有6个文档,而 Notes 6/6 (introduct@6) 则会以到达顺序累积笔记. 当所有6份文件都可供作出第一项决定时,两者都很少出现过多的检索分歧。

blocks.en: The pattern changes when decisions are made after only two arrivals (Notes 2/6, native@2 ). Retrieved-set disagreement exceeds same-order repeat variation by 11.6–23.8 pp across all eight model–task settings. Different delivery orders expose the decision to different subsets of the same original packet. Because the retriever is deterministic and no retrieval feedback precedes this decision, the schedule effect enters through whether and what the agent chooses to search.
blocks.zh: 只在两次抵达后才作出决定时,情况会发生变化(注2:6,本土@2)。 在所有8个模式任务设置中,检索到的数据集的分歧超过同顺序的重复变化11.6–23.8页。 不同的交付命令将决定暴露于同一个原始包的不同子集. 由于检索器具有确定性,且此决定之前没有检索回馈,因此调度效应通过代理商是否选择和选择什么来输入搜索.

blocks.en: To distinguish the selected evidence from its presentation, Batch 2/6 ( wait_all@2 ) presents the first two arrivals together in document-identifier order. Substantial sensitivity remains in every tested setting. On 2Wiki compositional questions, the primary evaluation yields 21.7 pp of excess disagreement, versus 21.6 pp with incremental processing. The same pattern appears in the GPT replication, with early incremental/batch contrasts of 12.7/12.5 pp on HotpotQA and 11.7/11.2 pp on MuSiQue (Appendix Table E1 ). Sorting fixes presentation but cannot make evidence still in flight available to the decision.
blocks.zh: 为了将选定的证据与介绍区分开来,批次2/6(wait_all@2)按文件识别顺序将前两名到达者合并列出。 每一个试验场景都保持高度敏感性。 在2Wiki的构成问题上,初级评价得出21.7页的过份分歧,而21.6页为递增处理. 同样的模式出现在GPT复制中,早期增量/批量对比在HotpotQA上为12.7/12.5pp,而MuSiQue上为11.7/11.2pp(附录表E1)。 排序可修正列报方式,但不能使仍在飞行中的证据可供决定使用。

blocks.en: Scheduling also changes access to useful support. Under early commitment, disagreement about whether the missing document is recovered exceeds the repeat baseline by 7.7 pp on bridge comparison and 19.3 pp on compositional questions in the primary evaluation (Appendix E ). These controls identify temporal evidence selection , in which timing shapes the evidence used to form a query and redirects corpus access despite a fixed packet and retrieval rule.
blocks.zh: 时间安排还更改了获取有用支持的途径。 在早期承诺下,关于是否收回所缺文件的分歧超过了重复基准,关于桥面比较的7.7页和关于初级评价的组成问题的19.3页(附录E)。 这些控制措施确定了时间证据选择,在时间选择中,尽管有固定的包和检索规则,但时间决定了用于形成查询的证据,并重定向了实体访问。

blocks.en: 3.2. Input Completion Does Not Ensure Informational Convergence
blocks.zh: 3.2. 输入完成不能确保信息汇合

blocks.en: Completing delivery gives agents the same original documents, but their acquired evidence and notes may differ. To test whether these histories still affect information seeking, Probe 6/6 records a new search-or-answer proposal after six arrivals without executing it.
blocks.zh: 完成交付给代理人的原始文件相同,但他们获得的证据和笔记可能有所不同. 为了检验这些历史是否仍然影响寻找信息的工作,第6/6号探测器记录了在六名到达后没有执行的一项新的搜索或回答建议。

blocks.en: The implied retrieval sets still disagree by 5.5–14.7 pp above repeat variation across six task–model comparisons (Figure 2 ; Appendix Figure E1 ). Unlike waiting before the first decision (Notes 6/6), completing delivery after early acquisition leaves subsequent search sensitive to the prior schedule.
blocks.zh: 上文5.5至14.7页的暗示检索套件仍然有分歧,重复了六个任务-模型比较(图2;附录图E1)。 与第一次判决之前的等待不同(注6/6),在早期收购后完成交付后,后续的搜索会与之前的时间表保持敏感.

blocks.en:
Table 1 distinguishes whether to search from what to retrieve. Search demand remains sensitive in every task, reaching 14.7 pp of excess disagreement on compositional questions. Even when both runs choose to search, their queries imply different document sets, with direction contrasts of 4.3 and 6.2 pp on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, respectively.
These outcomes separate two consequences of an earlier acquisition history. It can alter whether the agent seeks more information at all, and it can redirect the evidence sought even when both trajectories choose to continue.

表1区分了是否搜索和检索。 在每项任务中,搜索需求仍然敏感,在组成问题上存在过多分歧,达到14.7页。 即使两个运行选择搜索时,他们的查询也意味着不同的文件集,在HotpotQA和MuSiQue上的方向对比分别为4.3和6.2pp.
这些结果将早期收购史的两个后果分开. 它可以改变代理人是否完全寻求更多的信息,甚至当两种轨迹都选择继续时,它也可以重新定位所寻求的证据.

On 100 compositional questions, GPT-5.6 yields cumulative acquisition contrasts of 10.4 pp for early commitment and 2.4 pp for complete-input commitment, a paired difference of 8.0 pp [5.5, 10.4] . Further search can recover support without eliminating this dependence in the accumulated evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们允许在输入完成后进行第二次搜索,并允许任何第一次搜索反馈。 在100个组成问题上,GPT-5.6对早期承诺的累积获取对比为10.4页,对完全投入承诺的累积获取对比为2.4页,对比相差8.0页[5.5,10.4]. 进一步搜索可以在不消除所积累的证据中的这种依赖性的情况下收回支持.

blocks.en: 3.3. Acquisition Quality Beyond Final Accuracy
blocks.zh: 3.3. 超越最终准确性的获取质量

blocks.en: Table 2. Waiting makes searches more selective. Differences are complete-input minus early commitment (pp). Support recovery is the fraction of searches finding the withheld document; brackets give paired 95% CIs for accuracy.
blocks.zh: 页:1 2. 等待使得搜索更具选择性。 差异是完全输入减去早期承诺 (pp). 支持回收是查找被扣文件的搜索分数;括号给出95%的CI,以保证准确性.

blocks.en: We next examine what these acquisition differences mean for support recovery and answer accuracy. Under the single-search budget, waiting reduces search use and increases recovery per search across all eight incremental settings (Table 2 ). Both agents also recover more support overall and answer more accurately on both 2Wiki tasks. In the primary bridge-comparison evaluation, recovery rises from 13.2% to 79.6%, alongside a 30.3 pp accuracy gain. Search productivity improves across tasks even though accuracy changes are much smaller on HotpotQA and MuSiQue.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查这些购置差异对支助回收和答复准确性意味着什么。 在单搜索预算下,等待会减少搜索的使用并增加所有8个增量设置的每次搜索的恢复(表2.). 两个特工还全面恢复了更多的支持,更准确地回答两个2Wiki的任务. 在初级桥接比较评价中,回收率从13.2%上升到79.6%,同时提高30.3页的精度。 尽管HotpotQA和MuSiQue的精度变化要小得多,但搜索生产率在各项任务之间都有所提高.

blocks.en: In the two-search evaluation, early commitment reaches 43.6% accuracy versus 40.9% for complete-input commitment, a paired gain of 2.7 pp [0.4, 5.1]. It uses 1.54 versus 1.13 searches per trajectory, with support recovery at 84.4% and 83.5%. Higher accuracy and frequent support recovery coexist with greater schedule sensitivity in the acquired evidence (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在两项研究评价中,早期承诺的准确度达到43.6%,而完成投入承诺的准确度为40.9%,对等收益为2.7页[0.4, 5.1]。 它使用1.54比1.13的每道搜索,支持回收率为84.4%和83.5%. 准确度较高和经常获得支助,同时在获得的证据中更敏感地注意时间表(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: The complete-input controls clarify what a stable policy should preserve. On the primary bridge-comparison task, batch reasoning almost never searches and reaches 66.4% accuracy, versus 89.8% for incremental reasoning. Both have low sensitivity, but incremental reasoning recovers more support (Appendix Table E1 ). Stability is compatible with productive retrieval; the reasoning program shapes how effectively the available evidence guides search.
blocks.zh: 完全投入控制澄清了稳定政策应保持什么。 在主桥-比对任务上,批量推理几乎从来没有搜索过,并且达到66.4%的精度,相对于递增推理的89.8%. 两者的灵敏度都较低,但递增推理恢复了更多的支持(附录表E1. 稳定性与生产性检索是相容的;推理程序决定了现有证据如何有效地指导搜索。

blocks.en: Different evidence paths can produce the same correct answer (Appendix B ). The design objective is to preserve useful acquisition while making evidence selection insensitive to delivery timing.
blocks.zh: 不同的证据路径可以产生相同的正确答案(附录B. 设计目标是保留有益的获取,同时使证据选择对交付时间不敏感。

blocks.en: 3.4. The Acquisition Cost of Early Invariance
blocks.zh: 3.4. 早期变化的购置费用

blocks.en: 4. Confluent Evidence Acquisition
blocks.zh: 4. 收集证据

blocks.en: We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which coordinates reasoning and search through their evidence and resource dependencies while allowing independent work to proceed.
blocks.zh: 我们采用 " 证据收集 " (CEA),通过证据和资源依赖,协调推理和搜索,同时允许独立工作进行。

blocks.en: 4.1. Evidence and Resource Dependencies
blocks.zh: 4.1. 证据和资源依赖

blocks.en: CEA organizes reasoning around the inputs assigned to each subquestion. A branch handles one subquestion, such as establishing a person’s birthplace in a comparison. The subquestion and its assigned initial documents form a dependency domain , fixed before delivery.
blocks.zh: CEA围绕分配给每个子问题的投入组织推理. 一个分支处理一个子问题,例如在比较中确定一个人的出生地。 子问题及其指定的初始文件构成一个依赖域,在交付前固定。

blocks.en: A branch begins reasoning once all documents in its domain have arrived, while other branches may still await their inputs. Changing delivery order changes when this branch is ready, but not which initial evidence it uses. CEA replaces commitment after a fixed arrival count with completion of the decision’s inputs (Section 3.4 ). Those inputs may still leave facts unresolved, so the branch can request further retrieval.
blocks.zh: 一个分支在其域内的所有文件到来后即开始推理,而其他分支则可能仍在等待它们的投入. 更改交付命令是当这个分支准备就绪时改变的,但不是它使用的初始证据. CEA在固定到货清点后取而代之的是完成决定的投入(第3.4节)。 这些投入仍然可能使事实得不到解决,因此该分支机构可以要求进一步检索。

blocks.en: In an explicit task graph ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) , retrieval calls identify which evidence belongs to each subquestion. Our controlled experiments use annotated chains, with two domains for comparisons and one for dependent chains. Subquestions provide starting entities and relations without revealing annotated intermediates or answers. With question-only plans, each document is assigned to the subquestion whose retrieval call returned it (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在明确的任务图(徐等,2023;金等,2024)中,检索电话识别出哪些证据属于每个子问题. 我们的控制实验使用注解链,有两个域用于比较,一个域用于依赖链. 子问题提供起始实体和关系,而不披露附加说明的中间体或答案. 仅限提问的计划,每个文件都分配给其检索电话返回的子问题(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: Evidence independence does not imply independent access to search. Even when branches form stable queries, they may compete for the same budget. In Figure 3 , giving one search slot to the first completed proposal changes which query executes across schedules. CEA allows independent proposal formation and resolves this competition through an allocation rule that does not depend on completion order.
blocks.zh: 证据独立性并不意味着独立检索。 即使分支机构形成稳定的查询,它们也可能争夺相同的预算. 在图3中,给第一次完成的更改提供一个搜索槽,这些更改将跨时间表进行查询。 CEA允许独立的建议书形成,并通过不依赖于完成顺序的分配规则解决了这一竞争.

blocks.en: 5. Stable Acquisition with Asynchronous Progress
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 同步获取稳定

blocks.en: CEA aims to retain the stability and answer quality of complete-input reasoning while allowing independent work to proceed. We test stability and search allocation, then evaluate question-only plans. Evidence recovery, matched reasoning controls, and timed execution assess useful search and efficiency (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: CEA旨在保持完全投入推理的稳定性和回答质量,同时允许独立工作得以进行. 我们测试稳定性和搜索分配,然后评价只问计划. 证据的取回、匹配的推理控制和定时执行评估了有用的搜索和效率(图4)。

blocks.en: 5.1. Stability from Retrieval to Answers
blocks.zh: 5.1. 从检索到答复的稳定

blocks.en: We first compare CEA with early commitment on controlled bridge comparisons. Excess acquisition disagreement falls from 21.5 to − 0.2 -0.2 pp with DeepSeek V4 and from 24.4 to − 0.7 -0.7 pp in the matched GPT evaluation. Changing delivery order now produces about as much variation as repeating the same order. The corresponding answer contrasts are − 0.6 -0.6 and − 0.3 -0.3 pp. On dependent chains, primary answer disagreement also falls from 12.1 to 1.0 pp (Appendix Table E1 ).

blocks.en:
Stable queries and stable acquisitions are distinct requirements. A branch may form the same request under every schedule, yet lose the opportunity to execute it when another branch finishes first.
To test why stable query formation needs stable allocation, we keep local reasoning fixed and give the shared search slot to the first completed request (Table 3 ). With one supporting document withheld, only about 1% of trajectories have two requesters, so fixed priority and first-ready rarely choose between competing queries.

为了测试稳定查询形成需要稳定分配的原因,我们保持本地推理的固定,并将共享的搜索槽给予第一个完成的请求(表3. 由于一个辅助文件被扣取,只有约1%的轨迹有两个请求者,因此固定的优先权和先备状态很少在相竞查询中选择.

The winning request determines which new evidence enters the selected branch and, through its answer, the final synthesis.
blocks.zh:
在同一个100个问题上,每个分支都拒绝提供终端支持,争议率达到80.9-82.5%。 根据两项规则,当地查询-目标分歧仍然几乎重复出现,但首先准备就绪的购置分歧增加了21.6页[18.3,24.8],准确性类似。
中选请求决定哪些新证据进入所选分支,并通过其答案确定最终综合.

blocks.en: Each local proposal is formed from complete evidence, so the difference arises when competing requests are converted into an executed search. The shared budget couples otherwise independent branches at this step. A completion-order rule turns their relative completion times into a choice of evidence. CEA assigns this choice to a schedule-independent rule, allowing proposal formation to remain concurrent while keeping timing from selecting the evidence used by later reasoning (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 每一个本地提案都是由完整的证据所形成的,所以当相竞请求被转换为被执行的搜索时就会产生分歧. 共有预算夫妇在此阶段独立分会。 完成令规则将其相对完成时间变为选择证据. CEA将这一选择指定为一条独立的时间表规则,允许建议书的形成保持同步,同时避免选择以后推理所使用的证据的时间(图3)。

blocks.en: 5.2. Acquisition from Model-Generated Plans
blocks.zh: 5.2. 从示范计划获取资料

blocks.en: The controlled analysis uses annotated chains to define dependencies. Here, a planner sees only the question and specifies subquestions and initial retrieval queries. Each retrieved document belongs to the subquestion whose call returned it, giving CEA its dependency domains (Section 2 ; Appendix A ). Generated plans contain either a single reasoning chain or two independent subquestions. In the latter case, one branch can reason while the other awaits its inputs. We fix each generated plan and retrieved packet across policies to compare execution of the same task.
blocks.zh: 受控分析使用注释链来定义依赖性. 在此,计划员只看到问题,并指定子问题和初始检索查询. 每个检索到的文件都属于其回电的子问题,赋予CEA其依赖域(第2节;附录A.)。 生成的计划要么包含一个单一推理链,要么包含两个独立的子问题. 在后一种情况下,一个分支可以说明理由,而另一个分支则等待其投入。 我们修正了每个生成的计划,并检索了各种政策,以比较同一任务的执行情况。

blocks.en: Table 4. Accuracy (%) with question-only plans ( n = 100 n=100 per task). Early commits after two arrivals; Shared uses complete-input shared history. Δ \Delta is CEA minus Early [paired 95% CI].

CEA retains complete-input stability and answer quality with these generated dependencies. Excess acquisition disagreement is 0.6, − 0.2 -0.2 , and 1.0 pp on 2Wiki, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue, comparable to the shared-history control that waits for all inputs (Figure 4 a; Appendix E ). Accuracy is also comparable to that control, while exceeding early commitment by 12.6 pp on 2Wiki and 3.6 pp on HotpotQA, with a − 0.1 -0.1 pp change on MuSiQue (Table 4 ; Appendix Table E1 ). CEA obtains its coordination structure from the agent’s own retrieval calls, extending stable acquisition beyond annotated chains.
blocks.zh: CEA保留了完整的投入稳定性,并以这些产生的依赖性来回答质量问题. 过度的获取分歧为:0.6,−0.2-0.2,和2Wiki上的1.0pp,"HotpotQA"和"MuSiQue",可与等待所有输入的共享-历史控制(图4a;附录E.)相媲美. 准确性也与这种控制相当,同时在2Wiki上超过12.6页的早期承诺,在HotpotQA上超过3.6页,在MuSiQue上则有−0.1-0.1页的变化(表4;附录表E1)。 CEA从代理商自己的检索电话中获取其协调结构,将稳定的获取扩展到附加说明的链条之外.

blocks.en: 5.3. Useful Evidence and Efficient Reasoning
blocks.zh: 5.3. 有用的证据和高效率的理由

blocks.en: On the controlled two-domain task, withheld-support recovery measures whether stable acquisition remains useful (Section 3.3 ). CEA raises recovery from 79.6% to 86.4% with DeepSeek V4 and from 63.0% to 81.4% in the matched GPT evaluation, relative to complete-input native@6 . The gain comes mainly from more frequent productive searches. CEA’s corresponding accuracies are 90.5% versus 89.8% and 87.7% versus 76.4%, respectively (Appendix Tables E1 and E2 ).
blocks.zh: 在受控双领域任务方面,是否稳定购置仍然有用(第3.3节)。 CEA将回收率从79.6%提高到86.4%,DeepSeek V4的回收率从63.0%提高到81.4%,与完全输入本地@6相比。 收益主要来自更频繁的生产性搜索. CEA的相应速率分别为90.5%和89.8%,87.7%和76.4%(附录表E1和E2)。

blocks.en: We next isolate the contribution of private histories. A matched 100-question GPT control makes six note-taking calls over canonically ordered evidence for the full question and passes the shared history to both subquestion decisions. CEA retains only each domain’s evidence and notes. The reasoning-call structure, allocation, feedback, and synthesis are matched. Both use 9.9 calls per trajectory, but CEA uses 6,877 input tokens versus 11,505, a 40.2% reduction, with accuracies of 87.3% and 86.0% (Figure 4 b). Keeping histories local avoids repeatedly carrying other subquestions’ evidence and notes into later calls. By combining subquestion outputs only at final synthesis, CEA uses the same dependency boundaries to stabilize reasoning and limit the context carried through local calls.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将孤立私人历史的贡献。 一个匹配的100个问题GPT控制系统发出6个笔记电话,对全问题的证据进行恶意命令,并将共同的历史传递给两个分问题决定。 CEA只保留每个域的证据和笔记. 推理调用结构,分配,反馈,和综合相匹配. 两者每轨均使用9.9个调用,但CEA使用6,877个输入令牌相较于11,505个,降幅为40.2%,速率为87.3%和86.0%(图4b). 将历史保存在本地,避免将其他子问题的证据和笔记反复带入以后的电话。 CEA只在最终综合时将子问题输出合并,使用相同的依赖边界来稳定推理,并限制通过本地调用所携带的上下文.

blocks.en: CEA can also coordinate different local reasoning programs. Incremental note-taking raises primary accuracy from 67.2% with Batch to 90.5%; GPT Batch reaches 89.5% versus 87.3% with incremental reasoning (Appendix Table E2 ). GPT acquisition contrasts remain near repeat variation with CEA, CEA (Batch), and shared history. CEA’s coordination rules accommodate either program, allowing local reasoning to be chosen for answer quality while preserving stable acquisition.
blocks.zh: CEA还可以协调不同的本地推理方案. 递增式记分法将主精度从带批量的67.2%提高到了90.5%;GPT批量通过递增推理达到89.5%对87.3%(附录表E2 ). 与CEA, CEA(Batch)和共享历史相比,GPT获取对比度仍然相差相去甚远. CEA的协调规则可以容纳其中任一方案,允许选择本地推理以获取答案的质量,同时保持稳定的获取。

blocks.en: 5.4. Progress through Local Completion
blocks.zh: 5.4. 通过当地完成取得的进展

blocks.en: We time the same CEA program under two release rules. Local completion starts each domain’s reasoning once all its inputs arrive; the global barrier waits for all initial evidence. On the two-domain task, first subquestion decisions finish 8.7 s earlier with GPT (100 questions) and 8.3 s earlier with DeepSeek V4 (20 questions). Across 800 matched GPT pairs, final-response time falls from 27.3 to 26.5 s, a paired 3.1% reduction [2.4, 3.8]. Accuracy is 88.3% with local completion and 88.1% with the barrier. DeepSeek V4 saves 3.9% [1.9, 5.9] in response time (Figure 4 c).
blocks.zh: 我们按照两个发布规则 给同样的CEA程序做时间 本地完成开始每个域的推理, 一旦其所有输入到达; 全球屏障等待所有的初步证据。 关于"双域"任务,第一个分问题决定先用GPT(100个问题)完成8.7 s更早完成8.3 s更早用DeepSeek V4(20个问题)完成. 超过800对对应的GPT对,最终反应时间从27.3秒降至26.5秒,对齐还原率为3.1% [2.4, 3.8]. 准确度88.3%,局部完成,88.1%有障碍. DeepSeek V4在响应时间中节省了3.9% [1.9, 5.9] (图4 c).

blocks.en: Local reasoning can finish during delivery, but final synthesis waits for all branch outputs and selected retrieval feedback (Section 4.3 ). This explains why local decisions advance more than final responses. All three staggered arrival profiles show positive mean savings in both agents, while simultaneous delivery gives essentially none (Appendix Table E2 ). This pattern ties the speedup to overlap between reasoning and delivery. Appendix Table E1 reports when the shared search budget permits retrieval to begin.
blocks.zh: 本地推理可以在交付期间完成,但最终综合等待所有分支输出和选定的检索反馈(第4.3节. 这解释了为什么地方决定比最后反应更能推进。 所有三种交错的到货配置都显示两种代理都出现了正平均节省,而同时交付则基本上无结果(附录表E2)。 这种模式将速度与推理和交付之间的重叠联系起来。 附录表E1在共享搜索预算允许开始检索时报告.

blocks.en: 6. Related Work
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 相关工作

blocks.en: Interactive search treats queries as evolving with acquired information ( Bates, 1989 ) . Language-model search agents build on neural retrieval ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) and generation conditioned on retrieved evidence ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Izacard and Grave, 2021 ) . Adaptive retrieval ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Asai et al., 2024 ; Jeong et al., 2024 ) , browsing agents ( Nakano et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , and learned tool-use policies ( Schick et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) decide when and what to retrieve during reasoning. Decomposition and interleaved reasoning guide subsequent queries ( Press et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Trivedi et al., 2023 ) . GAIA, AgentBench, and BrowseComp evaluate general-assistant tasks, interactive environments, and difficult Web information seeking ( Mialon et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Wei et al., 2025 ) . We complement these evaluations by examining evidence-path stability across delivery schedules.
blocks.zh: 互动搜索将查询视为与已获取信息一起演变(Bates,1989.). 语言模型搜索代理基于神经检索(Karpukhin等,2020年)并基于所取出的证据进行生成(Lewis等,2020年;Izacard和Grave,2021年)。 适应性检索(Jiang等,2023年;Asai等,2024年;Jeong等,2024年),浏览剂(Nakano等,2021年;Li等,2025年),以及学习到的工具使用政策 (Schick等,2023;Jin等,2025;Chen等,2025)在推理过程中决定取回的时间和内容. 分解和互出推理指导了随后的询问(Press等,2023;Yao等,2023;Trivedi等,2023.). GAIA, Agent Bench, and BrobookComp评价一般协助任务,互动环境和难以查找的网络信息(Mialon等,2024;Liu等,2024b;Wei等,2025.). 我们通过审查各交付时间表的循证途径稳定性来补充这些评价。

blocks.en: ReWOO separates planning, tool execution, and synthesis through evidence dependencies ( Xu et al., 2023 ) . LLMCompiler dispatches dependency-ready tasks concurrently ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and RAG-R1 learns multi-query parallelism ( Tan et al., 2025 ) . AsyncLM incorporates tool returns into ongoing generation ( Gim et al., 2024 ) , while Speculative Interaction Agents reason during outstanding calls and revise pending work ( Hooper et al., 2026 ) . Demonstration order ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , evidence position ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , and irrelevant context ( Shi et al., 2023 ) influence reasoning. Multi-turn studies identify retained assumptions ( Laban et al., 2026 ) and divergent information-seeking paths ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent work on ChronosAttack studies timing attacks on authentic tool responses ( Vashagh, 2026 ) . Its causal barrier buffers a decision’s observations for canonical presentation, sharing the complete-input waiting principle of our global-barrier control. We trace how timing affects subsequent corpus access. CEA coordinates local evidence dependencies and shared search allocation while allowing independent branches to progress.
blocks.zh: ReWOO通过证据依赖性将规划,工具执行和合成分开(徐等,2023. LLM编译器同时发送依赖准备任务(Kim等,2024年),而RAG-R1学习多克力并行论(Tan等,2025年). 自动同步 LM将工具返回纳入持续生成(Gim等,2024年),而Speculative Interactors则在未决呼叫中提出理由并修改待完成的工作(Hooper等,2026年)。 示范令 (Lu等,2022年),证据立场 (Liu等,2024a),和无关上下文 (Shi等,2023年)影响推理. 多回合研究确定了保留的假设(Laban等,2026年)和不同的信息搜索路径(Huang等,2026年). ChronosAttack的同時工作研究了正宗工具响应的计时攻击 (Vashagh, 2026.). 它的因果障碍缓冲了决定的观察,以进行空洞的展示,分享了我们全球障碍控制的完全投入等待原则。 我们跟踪时间如何影响 后续的物证访问。 CEA协调本地证据依赖性和共享搜索分配,同时允许独立分支取得进展.

blocks.en: Concurrency theory characterizes when execution order can vary without changing results. Kahn networks establish determinism under a fixed communication discipline ( Kahn, 1974 ) ; conflict-free replicated data types converge through structured updates and merges ( Shapiro et al., 2011 ) . CALM links coordination-free consistency to monotonicity ( Alvaro et al., 2011 ; Hellerstein and Alvaro, 2020 ) , while invariant confluence characterizes coordination requirements for application invariants ( Bailis et al., 2014 ) . Recent work analyzes shared-state anomalies and concurrent external effects in multi-agent systems ( Khan, 2026 ) . CEA addresses stochastic search, where retrieval supplies later reasoning inputs and locally stable proposals can still compete for a shared budget. By coordinating local evidence and shared search, CEA preserves the joint distribution of decisions, acquisitions, and answers.
blocks.zh: 当执行命令可以变化而不改变结果时,同币论就具有特征. Kahn网络在一个固定的通信学科下建立了确定性(Kahn,1974年;没有冲突的复制数据类型通过结构化更新和合并而汇合(Shapiro等,2011年)。 CALM将无协调一致性与单调性联系起来(Alvaro等,2011年;Hellerstein和Alvaro,2020年),而无常交汇是应用无常性的协调要求(Bailis等,2014年)。 最近的工作分析了多代理系统中的共享状态异常和并发的外部影响(Khan, 2026). CEA解决了有条理的搜索问题,在那里,检索后期提供推理投入以及当地稳定的建议仍然可以竞争共享预算. 通过协调当地证据和共享搜索,CEA保留了决定、收购和答案的联合分配。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: Delivery timing shapes which evidence search agents acquire from identical initial inputs, with differences that persist through input completion and a second search. Timing influences both the evidence available when queries are formed and which proposed query receives a shared search slot. Acquisition stability captures the reproducibility of the evidence behind an answer, complementing task accuracy.
blocks.zh: 提供时间是证据搜索人员从相同的初始输入中获得的形状,通过输入完成和第二次搜索持续存在差异。 在形成查询时,时间既会影响现有证据,也会影响拟议查询得到共享搜索槽。 获取稳定性掌握了答案背后证据的可复制性,补充了任务准确性.

blocks.en: Our acquisition-regret bound explains why invariance at a fixed early arrival count can restrict the use of informative evidence already received. CEA instead coordinates local evidence completion and shared search allocation. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, it guarantees joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers while allowing independent work to proceed. With question-only plans, CEA retains acquisition stability and answer quality comparable to complete-input controls. Matched evaluations show lower context cost with private histories and earlier decisions and responses with local completion. Coordinating each decision’s evidence and resource dependencies supports useful, reproducible acquisition without a global barrier while independent branches progress.
blocks.zh: 我们的收购-管制约束说明,为什么在固定的提前到达计数时的不一致性会限制使用已经收到的翔实证据。 CEA则协调本地证据的完成和共享搜索分配. 就固定计划和稳定的有条件反应法而言,它保证共同改变决定、收购和答复,同时允许独立工作继续进行。 有了只提问的计划,CEA保留了收购稳定性并回答质量可以与完全输入控制相媲美. 与之相匹配的评价显示,与私人历史相比,背景成本较低,而先前的决定和答复则在当地完成。 协调每个决定的证据和资源依赖性有助于在独立分支不断进步的同时,在没有全球障碍的情况下进行有用和可再生的收购。

blocks.en: Appendix A Measurement Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录A 计量议定书

blocks.en: Questions come from the 2Wiki and MuSiQue development sets and HotpotQA’s distractor validation set. Corpus sizes are 398,354 (2Wiki), 509,315 (HotpotQA), and 117,534 (MuSiQue) paragraphs. Eligibility requires top-five retrieval of withheld support using its original title. The agent never receives this query. Non-supporting documents retrieved with the question fill the remaining slots. Duplicate excerpts, truncated support, and answer-exposing chains are excluded; distractors are not answer-filtered. SQLite FTS5 BM25 ( k 1 = 1.2 k_{1}=1.2 , b = 0.75 b=0.75 , equal title/body weights, ties broken by identifier) combines sorted unique Unicode alphanumeric tokens with OR, without stemming or stopword removal. A frozen tokenizer caps excerpts at 200 tokens; notes allow 256 output tokens and decisions/answers 512.
blocks.zh: 问题来自2Wiki和MuSiQue开发集和HotpotQA的分心验证集. 公司大小有398,354(2Wiki),509,315(HotpotQA),117,534(MuSiQue)等段落. 资格要求使用原标题检索被扣支持的前五名。 代理从未收到此查询 。 附有问题的非佐证文件填补了所剩的空档。 重复摘录,截取支持,并排除了"答出"的链条;分心者不作"答出"过滤. Unused early search opportunities expire, but delivery continues after answering. The completed-input probe uses the decision prompt without a budget notification. Target-eligible n n is 195, 200, 75 in Figure 2 (a)–(c), and 98, 100 in Figure E1 (a)–(b).

Recovery per search uses cluster-ratio intervals. Missing acquisitions remain NULL; missing answers score zero.

blocks.en: Each extension has 100 questions, eight orders, two repeats, and two policies (3,200 trajectories). The two-search extension retains both opportunities (Section 2 ). The allocation experiment uses the fragmented profile below and varies only the allocation rule. First-ready selects the earliest completed search proposal. The contention extension retains the same bridge-comparison cohort and both roots, removes both terminal supports, and adds the question query’s four highest-ranked non-supports.

blocks.en: Twenty DeepSeek and 100 GPT questions have two repeats per policy/profile. Profiles are simultaneous; priority-domain-first/last (canonical delivery over 0–4/10–20 seconds, singletons at endpoints); and fragmented (0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 seconds). Elapsed time spans dispatch to response; resampling retains profiles/repeats. Pseudorandom dispatch interleaves eight trajectories with at most sixteen concurrent requests.
blocks.zh: 20 DeepSeek和100 GPT问题每个政策/简介有两次重复. 剖面图是同时的;优先域第一/最后(在0至4/10至20秒的切入量,终点为单吨);和零碎(0、4、8、12、16、20秒)。 延后的时间跨出响应的发送;再模拟保留了剖面图/重复. Pseudorandom 发送间隔 8个轨道,最多16个并行请求。

blocks.en: Distractors are assigned by unique matches to branch entities in titles, then contents. Unassigned items fill the smaller domain in evidence-identifier order, with ties broken by branch identifier. Partitions are fixed across schedules.

blocks.en: Planning precedes retrieval of six unique documents, three per domain in two-domain plans. Retrieval deduplicates the top-64 candidates, using the original question for fallback. Retrieval calls determine document ownership. Plans and packets remain fixed across policies and schedules. Two-domain counts are 38, 5, and 8 for 2Wiki, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue, respectively; other plans form one chain. Schema failures use single-chain fallbacks (29, 11, and 45, respectively). All questions and predefined strata are retained. Each question adds one planning call, averaging 171 input and 147 output tokens.
blocks.zh: 规划先取出6个独特的文件,每个域在两个域计划中取出3个. 检索去除前64名候选人,用原题回回回回回. 检索电话决定文件所有权。 各个政策和时间表的计划和包件保持不变。 双域计分分别为38个,5个和8个为2Wiki,HotpotQA,和MuSiQue;其他计划形成一连串. Schema故障使用单链回落(分别为29起、11起和45起)。 所有问题和预定义的层被保留. 每个问题都增加了一个规划呼吁,平均171个投入和147个产出符号。

blocks.en: The original 60,200 trajectories (59,200 formal, 1,000 reference) include 108 violations. Replication adds 4,800 complete runs; timing adds 480 (seven violations, 160 matched pairs). Budget extensions add 6,400 with full acquisition coverage; one missing first-ready answer scores zero. The 33,600 GPT expansion trajectories (12,800 cross-task, 4,800 reasoning, 1,600 timing, 14,400 automatic) include 33,291 complete runs, 307 violations, and two failures. Contention adds 3,200 complete runs; GPT bridge batch controls add 3,200 with three violations. Failures are retained; 156 structural pilots, three pilot plans, and 16 contention pilots are excluded.
blocks.zh: 最初的60,200个轨迹(59,200个正版,1000个参考文献)包括了108起违规事件. 复制增加了4 800个完整跑道;计时增加了480个(7起违规,160起匹配对)。 预算延期增加6 400个,涵盖全部购置范围;一个缺失的首发答案得分为零。 33,600GPT扩展轨距(12,800个跨任务,4,800个推理,1,600个计时,14,400个自动)包括33,291个全跑道,307个违规道和2个故障道. 内容会增加3200个完整跑道;GPT桥批量控制会增加3200个,有3个违规. 保留故障;排除156个结构飞行员,3个试点计划,16个争议飞行员.

blocks.en: Scoring case-folds Unicode, removes ASCII punctuation and whole-word a/an/the , and normalizes whitespace. Empty or missing answers score zero. Exact matching uses answer-ID-linked 2Wiki aliases/demonyms, official MuSiQue aliases, and canonical HotpotQA answers, with string matching for numbers and dates. All 452 numerically parseable matches in the primary audit agreed in value.
